features.text: Includes undersleeve, gear guards, and a patella cup for added coverage

features.label: Replacement strap kit
features.text: Replaces worn straps in the original fastening order to restore fit

features.label: C180 rocket compatible
features.text: Designed exclusively for use with the Ossur C180 Rocket pediatric knee brace

measurement: Choose the accessory kit based on the C180 Rocket brace size you already purchased. Brace sizes are Small (circumference 9.5 to 11 in.), Large (circumference 10 to 12 in.), and XL (circumference 11 to 12.5 in.). The Motocross Kit and Patella Cup are Universal fit and work with both the Small and Large brace. The Patella Cup measures 3 in. wide. The Strap Kit is size specific: choose Small, Large, or XL to match your brace. Match the accessory kit to the size printed on your C180 Rocket brace. If the brace label is not visible, compare its circumference to confirm the size. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
